g1_p_bad_classifier_oos.diagnosis: Classifier achieves modest AUC discrimination (0.60) and acceptable calibration (Brier 0.22), but bad-state recall fails catastrophically (0.089). At default 0.5 threshold, classifier misses 91% of true bad-state events. Lowering threshold would inflate FPR. Root cause: state-level features (median of universe-level X_t) are weak proxies for forward 1715-active-return state — informational gap.
remediation_required_before_admit: Threshold-adjusted recall at task-specific operating point (e.g., precision/recall trade-off curve)
Alternative bad-state proxy: 1715 holdings cross-sectional features (not universe median)
Multi-task: forecast active return continuous (not binary state)

bad_state_label_selected.selection_rationale: balanced base rate (~20%) + AC-M 2023 RFS empirical bound + matches alpha-research default prior

complement_scorer_4_stage_results.incremental_admission_check_a_option_inv: Under A-option (comp ⊂ 1715), all 4 stages converge to near-identical blend outcomes because they all draw from the same 1715 top-20 universe. Stage incremental gain mostly absent (max ΔSR 0.028 between S1 and S3, all 16 candidates SR cluster 0.505-0.533).

injection_grid_16_candidates.interpretation_pareto_size_16: All 16 candidates lie on Pareto frontier (no strict dominance) — strong evidence that under A-option constraint, the design space is fully tied. Differences come solely from a_t injection magnitude × scorer-specific stock reweighting within the 20-name 1715 universe.

production_admit_vs_canonical_weights_ba.production_admit_basis: STR_1715_AR_on_M4_R05_overlay_PG2 full 5-Layer overlay (Layer 1+2 alpha + Layer 3 M4 BOCPD + Layer 4 AR threshold + Layer 5 R05 R-Tail) over 255m PerformanceAnalytics standard
production_admit_vs_canonical_weights_ba.canonical_weights_basis: WT-D20260501_001/weights.csv (alpha-side stock selection only, 146 monthly OOS rebalances 2014-01 to 2026-03)
production_admit_vs_canonical_weights_ba.delta_sr_explanation: The production admit SR 1.9536 derives from the multi-overlay 5-Layer architecture (M4 scalar × β_AR × β_R05) acting on top of the alpha-side weights. The canonical weights.csv represents only the alpha-side; overlay scalars are applied at NAV-construction layer not weights-layer. DPL-RC blend should ideally inject a_t comp into the alpha-side weights AND retain the overlay layers — but optimization_package and challenge_note_optimizer do not specify how comp interacts with overlays.
production_admit_vs_canonical_weights_ba.implication: Forge cycle uses raw weights schedule only — does not reproduce 5-Layer admit SR. Same-period baseline of 0.68 (40m OOS slice) vs raw schedule 0.37 (146m) vs overlay-admit 1.95 (255m) — three different measurement bases. Cross-base comparison invalid (Backtest Contract v1.0 cross-base prohibition + L-282 PerformanceAnalytics convention drift precedent).
remediation_path: Path A (recommended): re-spec DPL-RC blend at NAV-level: NAV_blend(t) = (1-a_t)·NAV_1715_full_5_layer(t) + a_t·NAV_comp(t). Overlay layers retain on 1715 side only.
Path B: re-spec at weights-level with full 5-Layer overlay re-applied. Requires alpha-research + optimizer-research mandate amendment.
Path C: re-define complement as standalone strategy (not 1715-anchored). Drops architectural A-option constraint.

decision_rationale.primary_blocker_1_g1_fail: p_bad classifier recall 0.089 << 0.60 → bad-state forecast inviable as designed. Alpha-research alpha_package §G1 hard ABORT trigger fires.
decision_rationale.primary_blocker_2_architectural_invarian: A-option (comp ⊂ 1715) mechanistically forces cor ≈ 1.0 (axis_6 FAIL by construction). The architectural fix to address Codex C2 portfolio union ≤ 20 inadvertently eliminates orthogonality (axis_6 target ≤ 0.30 infeasible). Codex C2 disposition created a trade-off not anticipated in design phase.
decision_rationale.primary_blocker_3_baseline_mismatch: Production admit SR 1.95 (5-Layer overlay) ≠ canonical weights SR 0.37/0.68 (alpha-side only). DPL-RC blend at weights-layer cannot reach target SR 1.97 same-period because the 5-Layer overlay contribution is excluded. Alpha + optimizer packages did not specify NAV-level vs weights-level injection.
decision_rationale.secondary_blocker_drag_axis_3: complement drag 0.13-0.17 SR points (target ≤ 0.05) — small injection (a_max 5-20%) introduces non-trivial drag because comp scorer learned weights diverge from optimal 1715 risk-adj_AS weighting.
decision_rationale.secondary_blocker_bad_imp_nan: Test window 2018-08 to 2021-12 has zero bad_state events (def1_x3). Bad-state improvement (axis_4) unmeasurable. Larger OOS span (52m+) needed to span sufficient bad_state realizations.

deferral_path_forward: 1. alpha-research re-spec: bad-state proxy with 1715-specific cross-section features (not universe median) + threshold-adjusted recall operating point + alternative continuous regression target.
2. optimizer-research re-spec: A-option vs B-option (1715 universe-external, a_max ≤ 5%) vs C-option (rank-merge truncate) trade-off explicit (Codex C2 disposition options revisit).
3. Q-Lead mandate: blend layer specification — NAV-level (Path A above) vs weights-level — clarification before re-Forge.
4. Test window expansion: OOS test 51:90 → 51:end (40m → 40m, similar) — but include earlier subsample with crisis events (2018-10 / 2020-03 / 2022-09 known 1715 bad periods).

5. Re-evaluate Stage incremental admission: under A-option, all 4 stages converge — Stage 1 Linear PPP sufficient + interpretability bonus; Stages 2-4 marginal value; Codex C3 method-shopping ACCEPT precedent.
